a: JSON numbers are often doubles; large integers may lose precision in JS.
Prefer ISO-8601 strings for dates; JSON has no native date type.
Unsafe YAML loaders can execute code; use safe_load equivalents.
Python pickle can execute arbitrary code; never unpickle untrusted data.
Unknown fields can be preserved for forward compatibility.
Binary formats must define endianness explicitly.
Schema registries coordinate evolving Avro/Protobuf schemas in streams.
Always parse based on Content-Type; do not sniff unsafely.
Normalize Unicode (NFC/NFKC) when comparing user-facing strings.
